title: DA seeks P30M more for cloudseeding as Negros crop damage hits P41.9M

blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — The Department of Agriculture in the Negros Island Region (DA-NIR) is seeking an additional P30 million for cloud seeding operations before the year ends, DA Regional Director Albert Barrogo said on Tuesday, Oct. 27. Crop damage in Negros Occidental due to moisture stress caused by dry conditions has reached P41.9 million as of Oct. 23, a report submitted by the Office of the Provincial Agriculturist to Gov. Eugenio Jose Lacson showed. The report showed that rice field losses accounted for P38.2 million, while corn damage totaled P3.7 million. READ: Dry spell brought P16M in crop damage […]...
